notes.title: Achievement Unlocked: Improved Goal Nets!
notes.content:
Welcome to version 1.5.0, which offers the following improvements:

[h1]Stats & Achievements[/h1]

Often wished for, now finally available! Unlock achievements for scoring goals, winning matches, becoming champion and other accomplishments.

(Please visit http://steamcommunity.com/stats/347690/achievements/ to track your progress as there is no in-game achievements view yet).


[h1]Greatly Improved Goal Nets[/h1]

Enjoy the all-new, physics based goal net animations along with improved net physics.

Scoring has never been so much fun!


[h1]Fixed Crash on Replays after Red Card[/h1]

Fixed crash when activating replay after a player has been sent off.


Enjoy Natural Soccer!

~
Thorsten

notes.title: Natural Soccer 1.4.11 Available Featuring Various Gameplay Improvements
notes.content:
You keep on posting a lot of very helpful and constructive feedback about my game - thank you so much! - [b]I greatly appreciate it[/b]!

I took the most frequently mentioned criticism to heart and improved Natural Soccer in the following ways, which, in my humble opinion, [i]greatly[/i] further improve the overall gameplay:


[h1]Added Player vs Player Collisions[/h1]

From now on, players no longer just pass through each other, enabling you to shield the ball with a player's body and perform some impressive dribbling.

It makes the game more realistic and adds quite a bit of depth to the gameplay. Hope you'll like it too!


[h1]Added Manual Passing[/h1]

While automatic short passes are still available unaltered by [i]tapping[/i] the pass button, you can now perform [b]manual straight passes[/b] by [b]holding down the pass button[/b] instead. The longer you hold it, the more powerful the pass will be.

Those manual passes deliberately are [i]not[/i] affected by Aftertouch, as applying that would also let the newly controlled pass receiver run around in unintentional ways.


[h1]Greatly Improved Keyboard Controls[/h1]

I carefully improved the keyboard controls so that they're no longer only strictly 8-way and allow for more freedom.

But still, [b]I highly recommend playing Natural Soccer with an analogue controller[/b]!


[h1]Toned Down AI a Bit[/h1]

Actually, the most criticism I got about the game's AI is that it's [i]too strong/perfect[/i] ;-)
So I toned it down a bit by making it perform less perfect passing and disabled the code which made the AI block its goal in a close to impeccable way.

Hope you like the new features! Please let me know in the [url=http://steamcommunity.com/app/347690/discussions/]forums[/url]!

Enjoy Natural Soccer!

~
Thorsten

notes.title: ONLINE BETA AVAILABLE!
notes.content:
Hi all,

today, I am very happy to announce the first available BETA version of ONLINE MULTIPLAYER !

Please note though, that adding online multiplayer to a high paced arcade game such as Natural Soccer is a very tough task - and it actually is the first time for me to ever try to do so ;-)

So this is a very first test if online multiplayer in Natural Soccer is even feasible and doable by me :-) - worst case, it may very well show that that's not the case, so I would love to get your feedback on this VERY EARLY version of online multiplayer to see if it makes any sense to pursue the idea or not.

Please note that online multiplayer in Natural Soccer is highly dependend on a stable connection with a decent ping. So your experience may vary greatly depending on who you play against. So try to match up with your friends close to you geographically, if possible (listed close to the top of the player list).


[h1]IMPORTANT THINGS TO NOTE[/h1]

Adding online multiplayer requires a lot of code changes and additions. That means, even existing modes might now suffer from new bugs!

In worst case, you may even loose your settings/savegames when switching to the online branch! So please only take part in the test if it's okay for you to probably loose your league progess or having to re-install the game altogether if things go wrong.

And also be prepared to restart the game quite a lot (use ALT+F4 to quit) as there is no PAUSE or in-game menu in online mode yet (see below).


[h1]ABOUT THE ONLINE BETA[/h1]

The online beta still is very rough around the edges. Match making is very rudimentary, there is no PAUSE in online matches, no radar and more...

When running an online match, the game is preset with default settings - that is, most of your options (match duration,...) are being ignored and set to some presets for both you and your online opponent.

That is, you are always playing the same teams (set to all players having the very same skills for maximum fairness), fixed duration, no radar, preset camera settings and so on and so forth.

Online matches are always one on one for now - and you have to use a controller to play (no keyboard support!).

Of course, if online multiplayer proves solid & fun enough to become part of the official release, those things will be added in the future so that you may choose your own teams and settings for your online matches etc.


[h1]HOW TO ENABLE?[/h1]

Having said this, you can try it now by switching to the branch "online" in your STEAM client.

That is, you go to Natural Soccer's properties in the STEAM client, then choose the "BETAS" tab and switch to the "online" channel.

Please note that, for optimum performance, the usual rules for online play apply:

[list]
    [*]Prefer a cable over wifi
    [*]Choose opponents geographically close to you
    [*]Avoid other traffic (downloads, streaming) while playing
    [*]Enable the game to "pinch" your firewall, falling back to relay servers seriously impacts performance
[/list]


[h1]MATCH MAKING[/h1]

As mentioned before, match making still is very rudimentary. So, for the time being, please use other means such as phone, whatsapp, teamspeak, chat or mail to arrange an online match with your friend.

Once you select PLAY => ONLINE in Natural Soccer, the match making screen is shown.

On the left hand side, you will see all available players (or "Waiting for players..." if there are no other players yet.)

Wait for your friend to come online (by choosing PLAY => ONLINE like you just did) and appear in the list.

Click on his/her name once it shows up in the list to challenge him/her.

Your friend will be notified of this as your name appears in his/her "Challengers" list on the right hand side. He/she can then accept the challenge to immediately start the match.

If, on the other hand, you get challenged by your friend, you will see him/her on the right hand side.

Click on him/her in the right hand "Challengers" list to start a match.

Note: the one accepting the challenge will be hosting the game, the other will be the client. So it's best for the player with the weaker hardware to challenge the one with the more powerful computer.


[h1]YOUR FEEDBACK[/h1]

Please share your online experience in the [url=http://steamcommunity.com/app/347690/discussions/5/]forums[/url] so that I can see if it makes any sense for me to keep on working on online multiplayer or if it's just not (yet) good enough.


Thanks for your support!

Enjoy Natural Soccer!

~ Thorsten

notes.title: Natural Soccer 1.4.6 available!
notes.content:
I'm very pleased to announce 1.4.6, containing the following features developed over the last few BETA versions:


[h1]Optional [b]manual player switching[/b][/h1]

You can now optionally turn off the game's auto-switching of the player you control and manually switch players by pushing the left shoulder button (you might have to re-run your controller setup to assign the new left button properly).


[h1]Additional game speed options[/h1]

Besides slowing down the game a bit, you can now also speed it up with the new 105% - 125% game speed options.

125% game speed combined with the HARD dribbling mode make for a nice "Kick Off"ish feeling ;-)


[h1]Improved Audience Sounds[/h1]

Due to popular request, I greatly enhanced the audience sound by adding new chants and cheers.


[h1]Challenge mode with online leaderboards[/h1]

[list]
[*] You play against up to 10, increasingly stronger, teams.

[*] For each match won, your score increases by the level's multiplier times the match's goal difference - the higher the level the more points per goal.

[*] For a draw, you gain no points and the challenge continues with the next level.

[*] If you loose a match, the challenge is over.

[*] Reaching the final level and winning the match, gains you another 300 points win bonus.

[*] You compete against other Steam players all around the world and can check your ranking on the leaderboards. 
[/list] 


[h1]Improved AI[/h1]

Further improved AI for a more realistic, bit toned-down passing and more clever actions in general.


Really hope you like the new version :-) !

[i]~ Thorsten[/i]

notes.title: Natural Soccer 1.4.0 available!
notes.content:
Dear fans of Natural Soccer,

welcome to the best Natural Soccer ever, with the following new and exciting features:

[h1]New "Easy" Dribbling Mode[/h1]

There is a new dribbling mode with very tight ball control for those who find the "natural" one too "laggy". I strongly recommend to give it a try: "OPTIONS" => "GAMEPLAY" => "DRIBBLING MODE" => "EASY"

[h1]Sprinting[/h1]

Hold right trigger/button to sprint. While giving a slight speed boost, sprinting in possession makes controlling the ball harder. Sprinting is totally optional and can be turned off in the options.

Please note that you might need to setup your controller once anew ("OPTIONS" => "CONTROLLER SETUP") to assign the correct button to sprinting.

[h1]Extra Time & Penalty Shootouts[/h1]

Added optional EXTRA TIME & PENALTY SHOOTOUTS available through the "DRAW HANDLING" option.

[h1]Added 2x2 minutes match duration option[/h1]

A simple addition, but hopefully hitting the "sweet spot" for many league players.

[h1]Improved "First Touch"[/h1]

Now there is no immediate and perfect ball control anymore when hit by a fast ball but the ball bounces away realistically uncontrollable.

[h1]Improved goalies' positional play[/h1]

Goalies are smarter than ever before.

[b]I really hope you enjoy the new release - if so, please don't hesitate to leave a positive review on the game's Steam page ;-)[/b]

notes.title: Natural Soccer 1.3.0 available!
notes.content:
Dear Fans of Natural Soccer,

I am very happy to announce the immediate availability of Natural Soccer 1.3.0.

[h1]What's New[/h1]

[b]Formations and Tactics' Balance[/b]

You can now choose from several different formations and balance your tactics to create your very own style of play. CPU teams all play different formations and adjust their tactics to whatever happens on the pitch.


[b]Offside Rule[/b]

You can now choose to play with the Offside Rule enabled. Players will act accordingly, trying to avoid being caught offside, making it harder to create good chances and increase the game's realism.


[b]New and Improved Set Pieces Controls[/b]

There is a whole new visual indicator to make taking free kicks and other set pieces easier and more dangerous. Still, you can always opt to ignore the visual indicator keeping the pace high.


[b]Many More Improvements, like:[/b]

[list]
[*] More realistic player movement
[*] No more kit clashes
[*] Game is prepared for upcoming Editor
[*] Pre-match screen in leagues, showing the opponent and allowing to choose tactics
[*] Many many more improvments
[/list]

I really hope you like this release!

Stay tuned for more things to come!

~
Thorsten

[list]
[*] More realistic player movement
[*] No more kit clashes
[*] Game is prepared for upcoming Editor
[*] Pre-match screen in leagues, showing the opponent and allowing to choose tactics
[*] Many many more improvments
[/list]

I really hope you like this major release!

Stay tuned for more things to come!

~
Thorsten

notes.title: Natural Soccer BETA branch available!
notes.content:
[h1]BETA Version Available![/h1]

You spoke, I listened!

Thank you all for the many, many great ideas and suggestions!

As of today, there is a „beta“ branch available for those who are interested to try out the latest and greatest features of Natural Soccer. As these features are „cutting edge“ and might contain bugs, they are first only available to those of you who actively select the „beta“ from the game’s properties in the STEAM client.

Your feedback to the beta version is very valuable to me and greatly appreciated. 

Please help to find any problems or bugs the new features might have added to the game, so that I can fix them before they become available in the public release version for everyone!

[h1]What’s new?[/h1]
The beta version contains these new features:

[b]Greatly Improved Set Pieces Controls[/b]
There is now a visual indicator on set pieces (except penalties), and you generally have  options when executing them:
[olist]
[*]Shoot the ball using the indicator. Move the stick to change the direction or height of the trajectory. Once satisfied, start pressing SHOOT and release it once the desired shot power is reached. Remember to apply Aftertouch on free kicks for most dangerous attempts, as it even gets slightly boosted compared to normal play.
[*]Shoot the ball manually without the help of the indicator. Just ignore the gauge, move the stick in the desired shooting direction and press and hold CHIP to shoot. The longer you hold the button, the stronger and higher the shot will be.
[*]Pass the ball using the indicator. Adjust the indicator so that it point towards the team mate you want to pass to. Center the stick and push PASS to pass.
[*]Pass the ball manually. Just ignore the gauge altogether, move and hold the stick in the direction of the team mate to pass to and press PASS.
[/olist]
[b]Set Tactics Balance[/b]
You can now change tactics balance in-game. Hold PAUSE button down until „NEUTRAL“ appears in your score display. Move stick in your team's direction to change balance towards attack, or in the opposite direction to change balance towards defense.

[b]Added Offside Rule[/b]
You can now optionally play with the offside rule applied.

[b]Greatly Improved Players’ Positional Play on Corner Kicks[/b]
Both teams will now setup in a much more realistic way, making corner kicks more realistic and dramatic.

[b]Many Various Gameplay Improvements[/b]
I also tweaked the gameplay and AI in various ways to futher improve the game.

[b]What’s Next?[/b]
Natural Soccer is in constant development. The - by far - most requested feature is an Editor to change team and player names. As this is a rather heavy task it’s not yet done now, but I am already making good progress.

[b]So stay tuned for more to come - and enjoy Natural Soccer![/b]
